content.text: That sounds brutal, and two hours of screaming would flatten anyone. At 28 months, long screaming stretches soon after bedtime can be night terrors or a rough sleep patch. They're often worse when a kid is overtired. Tonight, try moving bedtime 20 to 30 minutes earlier. When the screaming starts, stay close and keep it calm and dull, with no talking or picking up unless they settle into it. Don't try to wake them.
